messages:
oncall-bot: Incident created: KV cache hotburst detected affecting inference tail latency. Pager sent to SRE oncall.

oncall-bot: Severity: P2. Symptoms: 95th/99th token latency spike, error-rate ~0.8% on text-generation routes using MQA/GQA.

emma: paging — I'm on it. initial read: continuous-batching queue growth on the kv-cache workers, memory churn, lots of eviction logs.

raj: seeing same. Prom graph: cont_batch_queue ~x7 baseline, kv_evictions spiking. A couple of nodes at 90% GPU mem.

linda: which models? customer reports slowdown for interactive chat (low tokens).

miguel: majority of traffic for the impacted routes are Llama-variant small-context + a few Mistral tails. Qwen also sees increased latencies but fewer errors. GQA paths are disproportionately hit due to recent routing change.

emma: note: we rolled a batching tweak in the last deploy 38m ago that relaxed max_batch_latency to 80ms -> 200ms for cont-batching heuristics. suspect regressed throughput/queue sizing.

raj: I can roll that back. prepping a revert to previous cont-batch config (max_batch_latency=80ms, max_batch_size=64).

linda: customer-impact: support-lead, any active customers complaining?

support-lead: we have 3 enterprise SLAs flagged. Two on Dedicated had paged support. customers reported timeouts and degraded assistant quality. Not wide 5xx spike, mostly tail-latency timeouts.

customer-success: flagged one top account (acct-324) - they will escalate if not resolved in 30m.

miguel: logs excerpt from kv worker: ```
I kv_cache.cpp: eviction triggered for prefix-42, estimated entries: 1.2M, last_touch_age_ms: 31234
W continuous_batcher.cpp: queueing latency=220ms, draining 1024 tokens
E runtime.cpp: allocator OOM warn - backing off alloc
```

emma: thanks. plan: 1) rollback cont-batch tweak to previous params (raj) 2) temporarily enable eviction-throttle (limit new allocations for prefix therapeutic) 3) pin Llama traffic to smaller batching variant (linda/miguel) 4) notify customers and set mitigations.

raj: rolling config revert now via deploy-bot: `deploy-bot: start-config-rollout cont-batching-rollback --target=kv-workers --who=raj`

deploy-bot: rollout started. 12/12 targets accepted.

raj: rollback applied to all kv-worker pools. watching metrics.

(2m later)

miguel: cont_batch_queue down ~60%, kv_evictions trending down. GPU mem pressure easing.

linda: good. errors dropping from 0.8% -> 0.12% and 99p latency improving. Still not at baseline yet.

emma: enabling eviction-throttle: setting `kv.max_new_prefix_alloc_per_minute=10` and `kv.eviction_pressure_cutoff=0.85`.

raj: applied throttle flags. Confirmed on 4 hot nodes.

miguel: also pinning Llama routes to the small-batch runner: `route-pin --model=llama-7b --runner=low-latency-small-batch`.

support-lead: informing customers: sent initial incident banner to acct-324 and two other flagged tenants. Message: "We're mitigating an inference latency event affecting some chat routes; rollback and mitigations in progress; updates every 15m."

customer-success: customer acknowledged, they asked for ETA; I provided 30-45m.

emma: monitoring: 5m rolling p95 back to 1.1x baseline, p99 ~1.8x baseline (was 3.6x). Good direction.

raj: will keep the revert for 1h to validate stability before re-evaluating the batching change.

linda: root cause hypothesis: the cont-batching relax increased max coalescing window, producing very large batch sizes for prefix-heavy GQA/MQA workloads, which stressed the KV cache (high cardinality prefixes leading to full cache churn). When eviction rate crosses threshold, we saw service-level latency cliffs.

miguel: model-specific note: Llama small-context calls were unexpectedly routed through the general-purpose cont-batcher due to a route tag regression in the last routing config. That amplified the effect.

emma: next steps for oncall handoff: - create follow-up ticket to hard-fail the cont-batcher for GQA/MQA-heavy routes (no autoscaling of max_batch_latency without perf sim) - add guardrail in deploy pipeline to detect coalesced batch size > 512 tokens for low-latency runners - schedule postmortem.

raj: taking handoff. I'll stay on until stabilized and hand to next oncall in 45m.

support-lead: prepping post-incident comms draft. Will include timeline, customer impact, mitigations, follow-ups, and ETA for full root cause analysis.

customer-success: request: can we add a temporary SLA credit for acct-324? Approving internal discussions.

emma: nice mitigation notes: also enable metric alert for 'cont_batch_coalesce_ratio' and 'kv_eviction_rate' with lower thresholds so we don't hit this blind spot again.

miguel: one-off hotfix idea (deferred to eng-runtime): add prefix-aware batching where high-cardinality prefixes bypass coalescing; reduces cache pressure. File a FR.

(incident health check)

raj: update: metrics stable for 12m. No new pagers. Keeping throttles and pinning in place.

oncall-bot: Incident status updated to: Mitigated. Postmortem required.

emma: handing to next oncall + postmortem owner assignment. Thanks all.

linda: follow-up ticket created: INC-2026-kv-hotburst-batching-rca. Assign: eng-runtime, SRE, and product.

support-lead: customer post-incident note scheduled.

customer-success: acct-324 confirmed mitigation is effective and appreciates quick response.

miguel: quick ops note to include in postmortem: include benchmark of cont-batching changes with prefix-heavy synthetic traffic.

emma: closing this thread when postmortem triage is done. :thumbsup:"
